description.value: The Bao Place is a Chinese restaurant on Edmonds Street specializing in bao, the pillowy steamed or baked buns popular across Chinese cuisine. Situated in the Edmonds neighbourhood, it offers indoor seating for cyclists looking to rest and refuel after a ride. Its cuisine focus makes it a distinctive stop among the more generic dining options along this corridor.
